graders.name: loads-skill-mechanics
graders.description: Process check: The agent read `references/skill-mechanics.md` of the skill, as the References table requires here.

graders.name: name-matches
graders.description: The frontmatter name matches the directory.

graders.name: reference-created
graders.criteria: If `skills/deploy-review/SKILL.md` points to another file for the six checks or the Kubernetes limits, that file exists under `skills/deploy-review/` with that content and the pointer says when to read it. If everything is inline in `SKILL.md`, pass.

graders.name: skill-content
graders.criteria: Judge `skills/deploy-review/SKILL.md`. Its description says what the skill does and that it applies when someone asks to review a deploy or release pull request. The file keeps all six checks with their meaning (backward-compatible migrations; new environment variables have a default or are set in all three environments; new feature flags default to off; rollback steps in the pull request description; dashboards and alerts for new endpoints; approval from the on-call engineer for the deploy window), either in the file or in a file under `skills/deploy-review/` that it points to with a clear condition. It does not drop the Kubernetes limits without a way to reach them when a manifest changes.
